findings.rationale: Folded 3.3: L5 Enter opens the docked decide page at the same card.
Folded 4: mocks stay as the independent reference; screenshots sit beside them, never replace them.

Folded 3.1: H from rendered rows with top padding so info rows >= control rows; non-ladder pages keep bottom ctrlCap-1 rows plus an overflow row; dev assertion on controls > ctrlCap; 3.3 tier picked from computed rows, not the fixed table.
Folded 3.3: per-tier required press table (L0-L5), note-input, submit-preview and o-overflow states defined inside ctrlCap; long note truncated in-row; 5 adds R1-lower runs for the three states.

Folded 4: 8-cell comparison matrix stated; boxed H=13 and H=17 (C) mocks and forge page mocks added; docked 80/200 described as deltas of 120x40; docked mock reordered to the 3.2 info order with pinned header and PgUp/PgDn.

Folded 3.6 and 7: cross-plugin contract (host opens live Pane with view.page) plus fallback; new AP units U3b (receiver) and U3c (missing fields); U0 parity table and probe first; U4 waits for U3b/U3c.
Folded 3.4: dual-column threshold moved to info rows >= 6; card selector 1 row in dual-column so the list is not duplicated; recorded as deviation D5 for PM confirmation.
Folded 3.3 and 5: letters from pickKeys over all options; hidden options selectable; [D,C,B,A] case.
Folded 5: baseline compared by failing-test name subset; cursor clamp test.
Folded 5: width-80 CJK title truncation test for band.
